textRuns.value: Value only what a decision CHANGES. Money already spent (sunk) never counts; the project's own new revenue, savings and costs do. Those increments walk the same chain as blocks 4–5: ΔEBITDA → ΔNOPAT → ΔUFCF, with the investment amortized straight-line and NWC recovered at the end.

Special cases from the same principle: paying down debt changes only the interest bill, so its return IS the after-tax rate saved (Kd × (1 − tax) = 4.90%); an acquisition changes flows by the target's earnings + synergies − integration, so the breakeven bid is the price where NPV crosses zero (= investment + NPV at the asked price: $129.5M vs the $150M ask).
